prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental discovery piece about a protein chain folding into a stable shape. Around 70 BPM, F Lydian. A long piano chain of nearby notes collapses, through trial contacts, into a compact chorale of strings and marimba. Searching, then settled. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No glitch as error, no drums.

[00:00–00:30] Linear piano chain, one note after another.
[00:30–01:10] Some notes leap back to earlier pitches (contacts); marimba marks hydrophobic huddles.
[01:10–01:50] Compact chorale forms; clarinet holds a stable core.
[01:50–02:30] Chain is gone; only the folded chorale remains, breathing once.
